resources.string: YT Auto brings YouTube to your car\'s Android Auto screen. It was built to help everyone enjoy videos on their dashboard: search, play, and control videos with the touchscreen or your steering wheel buttons. It\'s free, simple, and made for passengers and parked drivers alike.
Please drive safe. Keep your eyes on the road and only watch while parked.
